_contract: Copy to realms/profiles.json and edit, or let install/detect.py generate it. Paths are relative to the repo root unless absolute. Full field reference in docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

realms._comment: A server this panel starts and stops itself. The common case on Windows.
realms.name: My Realm
realms._db_note: Schema NAMES only. Host, port, user and password are read from this realm's own worldserver.conf at query time, so a moved database or a changed password needs no edit here.
realms.notes: Free text, shown on the Play tab.

realms._comment: A server this panel does NOT own: Docker, systemd, another machine, or a hosting panel. Server/World/Tools disappear; Play, Addons, Reference and Changelog work normally. paths.configs must point at a directory this machine can READ - for Docker, the mounted volume on the host side.
realms.name: Dockered Realm
realms.notes: Started with docker compose, not by this panel. If the container maps MySQL to a non-default host port, the mapped port must be what worldserver.conf says - that file is where the panel reads it from.

realms._comment: A second realm out of the SAME server directory, started against a different config so the two can differ (another port, another DataDir, Warden off). Its auth comes from a helper script rather than authserver.exe. Everything in `world` is optional - omit the block entirely and the panel starts the two servers the normal way. Full reference in docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
realms.name: Test Realm

world._logs_note: That config's own LogsDir - NOT paths.logs. Readiness is judged from the log this world actually writes; name the wrong one and a ready world reads as still loading, forever.
world._authserver_note: false = this realm has no authserver.exe. Starting one would take 3724 from the other realms for a process nothing here talks to.

helpers.name: authshim
helpers.label: Auth shim
helpers._port_note: Identity is the PORT, not the process name - every helper is python.exe. With a port the panel skips it if already up, waits 10s for it, gives it a step on the progress bar, and stops the right pid on the way out.

realms.notes: Helpers start after the world and only if it came up; they are stopped first on the way out.
